title: ONE GUNFIRE TAIL: TAKE OUT THE DUPLICATE
why: Pick 69 (space-aware gunfire) was already in the game since v23.77: gunLayers and gunTail give slaps indoors, a roll outside, a soft wash in the woods, a ring in a vault and a hiss over water, with a crack-then-thump for far shots. The v33.25 tail doubled it and broke his v10.58 note that a tail is a tenth of the crack or less. It is removed; the old tails stay exactly as they were.
now: Gunfire is back to its one tail per place (v23.77). The extra tail of the last build is gone.
